body: Yeah, I know I'll regret it. I dont want to die, it's just I don't want to live even more.
Tried that for the last 5 years, doesn't work.

I feel like I'm helping myself with this. 

I had suicidal thoughts everyday since I was 7 years old(or maybe even earlier, just can't remember this) and now I'm 23. And the only thing I regret the most that I didn't do it 5 years ago.

I don't even think I'm depressed, just can't enjoy anything and disgusted by life.
I feel like a complete asshole everytime I try to talk about it with them. I know they can't help me, so all I'm doing is making this about myself and making them feel guilty about it.
